_comment: Jodi voice agent - mid-call API tool (During conversation). Notation as in assess_risk.json. No real secrets in this file.
name: read_summary
description: Gets the mother's health history as a short spoken summary, after the backend checks that this phone is allowed to hear it. Call it when: a doctor or nurse is speaking on the mother's phone; the mother or a family member asks what is in her record; an ASHA asks for a mother's history; or ANY caller (including an unknown number) asks for the mother's or baby's health information. Never share history from memory or from other variables; only read summary_text. Say a short filler first ('Ondu nimisha...').
response_template: Allowed: @summary_allowed. Read this text exactly, without adding to it: @summary_text. If allowed is false, do not share any other health information on this call, but offer to take an update.
if_it_fails: Sorry, I cannot open the record just now. I will ask your ASHA to call you back.

mock_response.summary_text: Lakshmi, day 5 after C-section on 8 November. BP 150/100 on day 4. On labetalol. Baby 2.6 kg at birth, mild jaundice day 4, feeding well today. No open alerts.

not_allowed.summary_text: I can only share this with the mother, her family or her ASHA.

notes: Contract: docs/contracts.md section 4.3; access rules section 7. Every read is logged by the backend.

Discrepancy: contract 4.3 gives the denied text as 'I can only share this with the mother, her family or her ASHA.' while docs/red-scripts.md NOT-ALLOWED is 'I can only share health information with the mother, her family or her ASHA. You can still tell me any update and I will save it.' The backend should return the NOT-ALLOWED script; the agent reads whatever summary_text says.
The summary may contain the mother's name, so the agent must call this tool only when someone asks for history, never to 'check' an unknown caller.
